listing.name: Commander Keen 6 (Omnispeak)
listing.summary: Upstream route: Native reimplementation compatible with original saves; exact episode/version data contract documented. Limits: Use official homepage binaries rather than latest GitHub modding-preview package; separate episode identities. Keen4/5 need v1.4 EGA, Keen6 v1.4 or v1.5 EGA. Documented shareware route applies to Keen4 only; Keen6 has separate unavailable-retail acquisition caveat. Upstream platforms: Official v1.1 Windows x86 and x86-64 binaries, Linux x86/x86-64; later GitHub modding preview is a separate selection. Original data: Own Commander Keen6 v1.4 or v1.5 EGA data, with GAMEMAPS.CK6, EGAGRAPH.CK6, AUDIO.CK6 and corresponding version support data. Other revisions need compatible conversion; no supported new retail acquisition is established. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
